name: VL53L0X Laser ToF Sensor
fullName: VL53L0X FlightSense Time-of-Flight (ToF) Laser Ranging Sensor Module
tagline: Sub-nanosecond photon Time-of-Flight laser rangefinder with millimeter precision
description: The VL53L0X is a high-precision laser-ranging sensor based on ST's FlightSense technology. Unlike conventional optical sensors that measure reflected light intensity, the VL53L0X measures the exact flight time of 940nm VCSEL photon pulses to achieve millimeter resolution (up to 2 meters) immune to target color and surface reflectance.

pinout.name: I2C Clock
pinout.desc: I2C serial clock line (Arduino A5 / ESP8266 D1)

pinout.name: I2C Data
pinout.desc: I2C serial data line (Arduino A4 / ESP8266 D2)

pinout.name: Shutdown
pinout.desc: Active-LOW enable pin for changing I2C address dynamically

wiringNote: Shares the standard I2C bus. If using multiple VL53L0X sensors on one board, use the XSHUT pins to initialize them sequentially with unique I2C addresses.
libraryName: Adafruit VL53L0X (by Adafruit) or Pololu VL53L0X
commonMistakes: Leaving protective orange sticker on sensor lens during operation
Measuring beyond 2 meters without high-accuracy long-range profile
Exposing sensor to extreme direct sunlight without sunshade
